tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Write exactly #000000. Every stroke (outlines, inner details, texture) and every opening: keyholes, bung holes, the gap behind a handle grip, pits. As a fill only for marks smaller than about 5×5 units (rivets, nail heads, keyholes). The renderer swaps this string per map style.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Write exactly #FFFFFF. The main top surface of a piece: table tops, seats, lids, stone faces, the plinth top, bare skin and cloth. The renderer swaps this string per map style.

tokens.name: shade
tokens.usage: Write exactly #999999. Secondary surfaces: metal fittings (bands, hoops, locks, crossguards), darker wood (chair rails), anything sitting lower than its neighbour (a plinth step, a seat under a table top), contents (liquid, coins, soil) and hair. A surface, never a line colour. The renderer swaps this string per map style.

tokens.name: parchment
tokens.usage: Overview-card background only. Never inside a prop file.

tokens.name: grid-faint
tokens.usage: The 100-unit grid lines on an overview card, 1.5 units wide, on parchment. Deliberately faint (1.2:1): it shows footprints without competing with ink.

tokens.name: label-ink
tokens.usage: Prop id labels under each prop on an overview card, on parchment (8.3:1).

families.display: "IM Fell English", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "DejaVu Sans Mono", monospace

styles.name: card-label
styles.usage: The prop id, centred under its footprint, baseline 36 units below the props' shared bottom edge. 20 units at card scale; label-ink on parchment.

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: Headings on the style sheet's own cards; never in a prop.

styles.name: sheet-note
styles.usage: Specs and captions on the style sheet's cards, label-ink on parchment.

tokens.name: square
tokens.usage: One grid square in prop units. A prop w×h squares has viewBox="0 0 {w*100} {h*100}" and the same width and height.

tokens.name: margin
tokens.usage: Keep every mark, stroke width included, at least 4 units inside the viewBox edge. Geometry with a 4-unit outline therefore stays 6 units in.

tokens.name: map-square
tokens.usage: One square as Roll20 renders it. Judge every prop at this size: 4 units = 2.8 px, 2 units = 1.4 px, 1.5 units ≈ 1 px.

tokens.name: radius-joinery
tokens.usage: Corners of built boxes: chest lids, crates, lock plates (2–3 units).

tokens.name: radius-worn
tokens.usage: Corners of seats, cushions and worn furniture (5–6 units).

stroke.note: The only three stroke widths, always with stroke-linecap="round" and stroke-linejoin="round".

tokens.name: stroke-outline
tokens.usage: The silhouette of each separate piece: table top, chair seat, chair rail, chest lid, barrel hoop, plinth, a figure's cloak.

tokens.name: stroke-detail
tokens.usage: Construction inside a piece: board seams, iron bands, lock plates, handles, inner rims, a figure's head and arms inside its silhouette.

tokens.name: stroke-texture
tokens.usage: Sparse surface texture: wood grain, stave joints, cracks, cloth folds, hair seams. Roughly one mark per 20×20 units at most.

wobble.note: Peak sideways drift of the hand-inked line, in units: one slow swell per 50–130 units plus quieter ripples. Uneven when zoomed, crisp at 70 px.

tokens.name: wobble-outline
tokens.usage: Outlines of large pieces (0.3 on pieces under 40 units across).

tokens.name: wobble-detail
tokens.usage: Seams, bands, inner rims (0.1–0.2 on small hardware).

tokens.name: wobble-texture
tokens.usage: Grain and cracks; grain may also bow up to 1.2 units over its length.
